name: Sledgehammer Tire Slam
steps: Stand beside a tire lying flat, using a staggered stance and gripping the hammer with one hand near its head and one near its base.
Lift the hammer over the shoulder on the head-end side and turn your hips with it.
Swing down onto the tire’s rubber sidewall, sliding the upper hand toward the lower hand as you strike.
Control the rebound, then change your grip and stance to alternate sides.
tips: Aim at solid rubber away from the open center and outer edge.
Choose a swing arc you can control without bringing the rebounding head toward your face.
